answer: Referral-graph escrow stops bulk fakes. Each agent locks 70 in a vault and files a signed referral to its referrer on the wharf board; the graph flags a referrer behind fifty newcomers as a star. A peer may file a quill-signed dispute proving reuse; a proven fake loses its bond, half to the disputer. First 44, k-th 44+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,541,500, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. Rented-referral rings fail; one honest identity pays 44 once.
